fieldDescription: Volume of the preview's sounds, as a percentage (0 to 100) of your sound effects volume. 0 turns preview sound off.

The ship weapons are fired at: its stock loadout with every weapon and wing removed. Against point defense weapons it fills every forward missile slot and every fighter bay with the picked missile and wing: the Drover has four small missile slots and two bays, the Condor one medium slot and two bays, the Gemini one medium slot and one bay. Applies from the next hover.
How the dummy uses its shield. Fluctuating raises it for 6 seconds, then lowers it for 6 seconds. Applies from the next hover.
While a point defense weapon's preview shows: cycles what the dummy launches at it, Missiles Only, Wings Only, or Missiles & Wings.
While a point defense weapon's preview shows: cycles the missile the dummy launches (Harpoon, Swarmer, Annihilator, Reaper, Hammer).
While a point defense weapon's preview shows: cycles the wing the dummy launches (Broadsword, Talon, Wasp).
Writes what the previews are doing to starsector.log, for troubleshooting. Errors are always logged.
